security_advisory.summary: urllib3's Cookie header isn't stripped during cross-origin redirects
security_advisory.description: urllib3 doesn't treat the Cookie HTTP header special or provide any helpers for managing cookies. As such, if a user is making requests with a Cookie header that should not be sent to a redirected origin (e.g. due to a cross-origin redirect), the cookie may be leaked. Affects urllib3 prior to 1.26.17 and 2.0.6.
